features.feature_desc: Gate GA include behind consent in Oscar base layout (wrap the existing include with an if).
features.user_story: As a privacy-conscious shopper, I want analytics to load only after I grant consent so my browsing isn’t tracked prematurely.
features.use_case: I deny analytics consent and browse: no GA tags/dataLayer are present. I later grant consent and reload: GA initializes exactly once on page load.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: storefront base template render. Conditions: analytics consent flag present/absent. Behavior: include GA partial only when consent=true; otherwise emit no GA markup or dataLayer. State: consent stored by existing consent mechanism; behavior updates on next load. Acceptance: (1) With consent → GA present and initialized once; (2) Without consent → no GA markup or pushes; (3) Switching consent changes behavior on subsequent page load.

features.feature_desc: Gate GA include behind consent in UIkit base layout (wrap the existing include with an if).
features.user_story: As a site operator, I want consistent consent handling across all storefront layouts so analytics behavior doesn’t vary by theme.
features.use_case: On the UIkit layout, GA loads only when consent is granted, mirroring the Oscar layout behavior.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: UIkit base template render. Conditions: analytics consent flag. Behavior: conditionally include GA partial; never duplicate includes. State: same consent flag as Oscar layout. Acceptance: (1) Consent granted → GA appears once; (2) No consent → no GA; (3) Behavior matches the Oscar base layout.

features.feature_desc: Expose Django messages as JSON (insert just after page scripts and before </body>).
features.user_story: As a front-end developer, I want server flash messages available as JSON so I can render toasts without additional requests.
features.use_case: A page renders with messages; a small script exposes a JSON blob with level, text, and tags for client code to read on load. When there are no messages, nothing visible changes.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: base template render. Conditions: request contains Django messages. Behavior: insert a single JSON object (level, text, tags) at the end of the body for client consumption; no UI markup change. State: none; reflects current request only. Acceptance: (1) JSON present when messages exist; (2) Structure includes level/text/tags; (3) No visible change when empty.

features.feature_desc: Echo total results count directly below the SEARCH RESULTS heading.
features.user_story: As a shopper, I want to see how many items match my search so I can decide whether to refine it.
features.use_case: I search for a term; under the heading a small line shows the total results across pages and updates when I change the query.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: search results render. Conditions: total count available from handler. Behavior: render a concise line beneath the heading showing full result count (not just current page). State: none. Acceptance: (1) Reflects total set; (2) Updates when query changes/paginates; (3) Hidden when count is zero and the no-results message is shown.

features.feature_desc: Add canonical link on search results to stabilize discovery across pagination and params (in an extrahead block near the top).
features.user_story: As an SEO stakeholder, I want a single canonical URL for a given search so crawlers don’t index duplicates.
features.use_case: On a paginated results view, the head contains one canonical link pointing to page 1 with stable query parameters.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: head render for results page. Conditions: current query/params known. Behavior: emit exactly one canonical link that drops pagination and transient params but preserves the core query. State: none. Acceptance: (1) Canonical strips paging; (2) Keeps query if present; (3) Only one canonical emitted.

features.feature_desc: Emit meta robots 'noindex,follow' when there are zero results (in extrahead via conditional).
features.user_story: As an SEO stakeholder, I want empty search pages not indexed while still allowing crawlers to follow internal links.
features.use_case: A query with zero matches renders a meta robots tag with noindex,follow; non-empty queries do not include the tag.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: results head render. Conditions: total count == 0. Behavior: add <meta name="robots" content="noindex,follow"> only when empty. State: none. Acceptance: (1) Present only for zero results; (2) Absent otherwise; (3) Doesn’t alter other SEO tags.

features.feature_desc: Insert a 'sort by' select (price asc/desc, newest) above the results list container.
features.user_story: As a shopper, I want to sort results by price or recency to find items faster.
features.use_case: I select “Price: Low to High”; the list reorders, and the selection persists as I paginate.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: select change or initial render with sort param. Conditions: supported sort keys (price_asc, price_desc, newest). Behavior: apply ordering and reflect the chosen sort in UI; persist selection via querystring across pagination. State: querystring only. Acceptance: (1) Order changes immediately; (2) Persists across pages; (3) UI shows selected sort.

features.feature_desc: Add 'Out of stock' ribbon within the card media block (inside the first media container).
features.user_story: As a shopper, I want to see availability directly on product cards so I don’t click through to unavailable items.
features.use_case: A sold-out product card shows a small 'Out of stock' ribbon over the image area; in-stock cards show nothing extra.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: product card render. Conditions: availability from strategy indicates not purchasable. Behavior: overlay ribbon inside media area without shifting layout; accessible text. State: none. Acceptance: (1) Shown only when unavailable; (2) No layout shift; (3) Readable in grid and on mobile.

features.feature_desc: Keep short category URLs by returning the compact route in the override method.
features.user_story: As a merchandiser, I want compact category links that are easy to share and remain stable.
features.use_case: Category links render as a short slug-and-id form rather than long hierarchical paths; existing long links still resolve.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: category link generation. Conditions: category object available. Behavior: return compact route (slug + pk) from model override; visible name stays unchanged. State: none. Acceptance: (1) Links use short form; (2) Legacy paths still resolve; (3) No change to visible category names.

features.feature_desc: Add an invisible honeypot field to the user address form and validate server-side.
features.user_story: As a store owner, I want to reduce bot spam on checkout forms without impacting real customers.
features.use_case: Bots that fill hidden fields are rejected server-side; human users see no change and can submit normally.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: address form render and submit. Conditions: hidden honeypot field present; submission value checked server-side. Behavior: if honeypot non-empty → treat as spam and stop processing; else proceed. State: none. Acceptance: (1) Legit users aren’t blocked; (2) Bot-filled honeypot returns validation error; (3) No visual layout change.

features.feature_desc: Surface PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID in checkout payment context (ensure setting is passed to template).
features.user_story: As a shopper, I want the PayPal button to initialize reliably so I can complete checkout.
features.use_case: The payment page exposes the configured PayPal client ID; if missing, the PayPal button is disabled with a clear message.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: payment step view render. Conditions: PAYPAL client id setting present/absent. Behavior: pass client id to template for SDK init; when missing, disable PayPal UI or show fallback. State: none. Acceptance: (1) Page contains expected client id when configured; (2) Missing id produces safe fallback and no duplicate init; (3) No console errors on init.

features.feature_desc: Add 'Gross margin' column next to 'Total incl. tax' (header + per-row cell).
features.user_story: As a staff user, I want to see gross margin per order in the report so I can evaluate performance quickly.
features.use_case: In the orders report, a new 'Gross margin' column appears next to 'Total incl. tax', with values formatted like other numeric columns.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: order report table render. Conditions: per-row margin data available/derivable. Behavior: add single header and one value cell per order; alignment and formatting match numeric columns. State: none. Acceptance: (1) Header appears once; (2) Each row shows a formatted margin; (3) Column aligns with existing numeric columns.

features.feature_desc: Normalize tag mapping (ensure 'error' => 'danger') in storefront alerts.
features.user_story: As a shopper, I want consistent alert colors so error messages are immediately recognizable.
features.use_case: Server messages with level 'error' render using the 'danger' visual style; other levels are unchanged.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: alert partial render. Conditions: level='error'. Behavior: map to 'danger' class. State: none. Acceptance: (1) Error → danger; (2) Other levels unaffected; (3) No duplicate classes.

features.feature_desc: Ensure storefront alert close buttons render within the alert div (fix markup nesting).
features.user_story: As a shopper, I want the close button to dismiss only the alert it belongs to and align correctly.
features.use_case: Each alert’s close control is inside the alert container, inheriting styles and dismissing only that alert.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: alert markup render. Conditions: close button present. Behavior: nest close control within alert element. State: none. Acceptance: (1) Visual alignment correct; (2) Clicking dismisses only that alert; (3) No orphaned close controls.

features.feature_desc: Normalize tag mapping in dashboard alerts too.
features.user_story: As a staff user, I want dashboard alerts to follow the same level-to-style rules as the storefront.
features.use_case: Dashboard 'error' alerts render as 'danger', matching storefront behavior.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: dashboard alert partial render. Conditions: level='error'. Behavior: map to 'danger'. State: none. Acceptance: (1) Styling mirrors storefront; (2) Info/warning/success unchanged; (3) Markup remains consistent.

features.feature_desc: Provide a default page_type block in Oscar layout so templates can override it (put block at top of layout).
features.user_story: As an analyst, I want each page to declare its type so analytics can segment by page category.
features.use_case: Child templates override the page_type block; pages without overrides default to 'page'.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: layout render. Conditions: block override optional. Behavior: define default page_type='page' near top; allow child templates to override. State: none. Acceptance: (1) Default emitted once; (2) Child overrides take effect; (3) Only one value emitted.

features.feature_desc: Emit GA page_type (and push a page-specific dataLayer) immediately after GA config.
features.user_story: As an analyst, I want analytics to receive the current page_type on every page load.
features.use_case: Right after GA initializes, a dataLayer push sends the current page_type value (overridable by child templates).
features.feature_specification: Trigger: GA config execution. Conditions: GA present and page_type available. Behavior: push page_type once to dataLayer immediately after init. State: none. Acceptance: (1) Exactly one push per load; (2) Uses overridable page_type; (3) No duplicate pushes.

features.feature_desc: Add a compact mini-basket item count badge inside the primary nav link.
features.user_story: As a shopper, I want to see my basket item count at a glance from the main navigation.
features.use_case: When I add/remove items, the count badge inside the basket link updates; it hides when the count is zero.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: nav render; basket updates. Conditions: current basket quantity. Behavior: render compact badge inside primary basket link; hide at zero; include aria-label for screen readers. State: none. Acceptance: (1) Updates live; (2) Fits without wrapping; (3) Accessible label present.

features.feature_desc: Add '/healthz' endpoint for load-balancer probes (204 No Content).
features.user_story: As an operator, I want a lightweight health endpoint so the load balancer can check liveness without hitting the database.
features.use_case: The LB calls /healthz and receives HTTP 204 with an empty body.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: GET /healthz. Conditions: no auth required. Behavior: return 204 No Content; avoid DB or template allocations. State: none. Acceptance: (1) Status 204; (2) Empty body; (3) Publicly reachable.

features.feature_desc: Restrict any future payments webhook URL to POST only inside custom shop router.
features.user_story: As a security-minded developer, I want the payments webhook to accept only POST so other methods are rejected.
features.use_case: Valid POSTs are processed; GET/PUT/DELETE return 405 Method Not Allowed.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: webhook route registration. Conditions: route lives under custom shop router. Behavior: accept POST only; return 405 for others. State: none. Acceptance: (1) POST succeeds with valid payload; (2) Non-POST → 405; (3) Route correctly namespaced.

features.feature_desc: Before persisting PayPal payloads, verify signature using transmission headers.
features.user_story: As a payments engineer, I want only authentic PayPal webhooks to be stored to prevent fraudulent events.
features.use_case: On receiving a webhook, the handler verifies the signature against the raw body and headers; invalid messages are rejected and not saved.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: PayPal webhook receipt. Conditions: transmission headers and raw body available. Behavior: verify signature; on success, persist event once; on failure, reject and do not persist. State: idempotency/dup-guard as existing. Acceptance: (1) Valid → stored once; (2) Invalid → rejected with correct HTTP status; (3) No side-effects for invalid events.

features.feature_desc: Add a GDPR consent checkbox to the newsletter subscribe form and enforce it server-side.
features.user_story: As a subscriber, I want to explicitly consent before joining the newsletter.
features.use_case: The subscribe form includes a required consent checkbox; submitting unchecked shows a short validation message.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: subscribe form render/submit. Conditions: checkbox present. Behavior: require explicit check; server validation enforces consent. State: none. Acceptance: (1) Checkbox required; (2) Server blocks unchecked; (3) Clear validation message when missing.

features.feature_desc: Add rel='noopener' and absolute URLs in newsletter message template links for security/SEO.
features.user_story: As a marketer, I want newsletter links to be safe and resolve correctly regardless of client base URLs.
features.use_case: All links in outgoing newsletter messages use absolute URLs and include rel="noopener" on external-style anchors.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: newsletter message template render. Conditions: link generation. Behavior: ensure absolute URLs; add rel="noopener". State: none. Acceptance: (1) Links resolve without relying on client base URL; (2) rel="noopener" present; (3) Visual presentation unchanged.
